purpose: Independent Simulink port of existing behavioral Python platform and floating Gu digital candidate; implementation parity, not new algorithm, long-run study or physical certification.
time: One discrete tick per ADC conversion, tick n maps to Python sample_index n. Nominal physical sample rate 3e9 Hz is used for offline plots only.
inputs: Python generates and saves all inputs and dither tags once. Simulink only consumes stimulus CSV, never Python output or truth-derived coefficients. float64 CSV uses 17 significant digits.
budgets: Grid includes all 4096 ideal code boundaries and nextafter neighbors, all flash boundaries and neighbors, endpoints and all dither pairs. Other controls use 480 conversions each; adaptive controls 2400; coherent demo 4096 with bin127. Dynamic history advances on EVERY conversion, including unselected window samples. No million-sample rerun.
digital: Floating PWL widths128/32, negative endpoint extended on last slice, upper full scale rejected, stage2 correction then D2 subtraction then stage1 correction then D1 subtraction. Both banks score/gate from old coefficients and take effect on the next conversion. Modes:0 bypass,1 frozen,2 instantaneous,3 point30,4 full120. Window length120, point30 selects positions0..3 and commits at119, multiplier30; full120 selects every position and multiplier1. Window normalization matches original update_block_mean with adapted step mu*multiplier*selected_count.
checks: Every conversion, every trace field; primitive PWL endpoints and out-of-range rejection, gate equality and neighbors, all SAR edges, clipping flags, restart resets states. Direct feedthrough and feedback delays checked by model compilation and execution.
failure_policy: Retain dated runs and failures. Do not tune model parameters, learning steps, seeds, input budget or tolerance to make output agree. Fix port implementation only; document arithmetic discrepancies and rerun affected checks.
limits: Floating software behavior only. Existing fixed-point/RTL variants and continuous-backend offline oracle are not this model. Artificial analog curves, settling and update timing remain explicit research assumptions. No claim of silicon bit identity or convergence from short controls.
